p.src: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song.

en: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song.
u.src: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song.

p.src: 1  His foundation is in the holy mountains.

en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
u.src: 1  His foundation is in the holy mountains.

p.src: 2  The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

en: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
u.src: 2  The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

p.src: 3  Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

en: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
u.src: 3  Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

p.src: 4  I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

en: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
u.src: 4  I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

en: 87:4 Rahab is a reference to Egypt.

p.src: 5  Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

en: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
u.src: 5  Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

p.src: 6  The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

en: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
u.src: 6  The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

p.src: 7  Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

en: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
u.src: 7  Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
